name: Residence Permit for Commercial/Business Activities

requirements.blocker_text: Company registration certificate and articles of incorporation for a Romanian business.
Proof of financial means: EUR 500/month for associates, EUR 700/month for shareholders (waived above the investment/job-creation thresholds below).

requirement_groups.name: EUR 150,000+ investment or 25+ jobs created (financial proof waived)

requirements.blocker_text: Investment of at least EUR 150,000, OR creation of at least 25 jobs, waives the standard monthly financial-proof requirement.

requirement_groups.name: EUR 500,000+ investment or 50+ jobs created (3-year permit)

requirements.blocker_text: Investment of at least EUR 500,000, OR creation of at least 50 jobs, qualifies for a 3-year permit instead of the standard 1-year renewable permit.

evidence_required.document: Company registration certificate and articles of incorporation
Notice from the Romanian Centre for the Promotion of Foreign Investments
Medical certificate and proof of social insurance
Proof of legal possession of business and residential addresses

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, renewable (3 years at the EUR 500,000+/50-job threshold)

sources.title: General Inspectorate for Immigration (IGI), Romanian Ministry of Internal Affairs -- residence permit for commercial activities: EUR 500/month (associates) or EUR 700/month (shareholders) standard financial proof; waived at EUR 150,000 investment or 25 jobs; waived at EUR 200,000 investment or 50 jobs; 3-year permit at EUR 500,000 investment or 50 jobs; renewal requires Ministry of Business technical approval and Labor Territorial Inspectorate employment certificate

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Romania). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 IGI sourced, with concrete tiered investment/job-creation thresholds (unusual level of specificity for this dataset's business/investor routes). This is a residence route only -- it does NOT lead to a distinct fast-track citizenship-by-investment status; Romania has no citizenship-by-investment program (confirmed absent -- multiple tier-3 sources explicitly state 'Romania citizenship by investment is not available', and proposed 2025-era golden-visa/residency-by-investment legislation was still only a legislative proposal, not a live scheme, as of this pass -- disclosed rather than modeled as a route). The source describes a EUR 200,000/50-job tier between the 150k and 500k tiers with 'no financial proof requirement' but does not distinguish its permit duration from the standard 1-year renewable permit, so only the 150k (proof-waiver) and 500k (3-year duration) tiers are modeled as distinct requirement groups here; the 200k tier's practical effect on top of the 150k waiver is unclear from the source and flagged as a gap. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months are inferred from Romania's general long-term-residence and naturalisation thresholds (see ro_permanent_residence.json, ro_citizenship_naturalisation.json), not separately confirmed for investor-route holders specifically.
